message:
The yen receipt test now passes, along with the pounds one (2 of 2). A yen receipt now reads `Paid ¥500 by card`.

The bug is in the shared formatter, `src/utils/money.js`. It divides every amount by 100, so 500 yen came out as `¥5.00`. That file is outside `src/payments/`, so I left it alone. Instead, `src/payments/receipt.js` now formats JPY amounts itself and sends every other currency through the shared formatter as before.

The invoices code in `src/invoices/render.js` probably has the same yen problem, since it shares that formatter. I didn't check it. The better long-term fix is a currency-aware `formatMoney`, which would be a change for whichever team owns `src/utils/`. If they make it, the JPY special case in `receipt.js` can come out.
